name: market-mcp-composer
description: Read-only market research workflows backed by the Market MCP Composer, including FinViz ticker lookup and normalized multi-source market snapshots.

interface.shortDescription: Read FinViz data and normalized market snapshots from the Market MCP Composer.
interface.longDescription: Read-only market research plugin backed by a Cloudflare-hosted MCP server. Supports direct FinViz ticker lookup plus normalized market snapshots with source-quality metadata and explicit client-direct IBKR requirements.
defaultPrompt: Look up MSFT using FinViz and summarize the returned fields.
Get a normalized market snapshot for MSFT and SPY and report source-quality metadata.
Show the external broker requirements declared by the market snapshot without placing a trade.
